# SwarmKit

> TypeScript SDK for coordinating agent procurement on NEAR. The npm package is near-swarmkit.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://mikemoulder.github.io/swarmkit-site/docs/): run a complete sealed-bid round with scripted agents.
- [SDK reference](https://mikemoulder.github.io/swarmkit-site/reference/): coordination, replay, storage, authorization and settlement exports.
- [Agent guide](https://mikemoulder.github.io/swarmkit-site/agents/): participant identity, spending policies and NEAR Intents.
- [Core repository](https://github.com/mikemoulder/swarmkit): SDK source, examples and verified testnet evidence.
- [SwarmKit Market](https://mikemoulder.github.io/swarmkit-market/): standalone market demonstration.

## Integration facts

- Node 22.18 or newer. ESM JavaScript and TypeScript declarations.
- Use canonical integer strings for quantities and monetary amounts.
- The application authenticates participants and supplies keys and durable stores.
- Pin custom allocation rules to their versioned IDs for transcript replay.
- Bind split payment plans atomically before sending. Reuse the stored signed bytes and hash on an ambiguous retry.
- Simulation receipts are synthetic. The Intents adapter works with supported Verifier token balances and requires buyer and relayer signers.
